verdict.rationale: CRA's own EFILE pages document a remote credential sign-in using an EFILE number and password, which is a credential-based path rather than biometric or in-person. The pack never mentions a second factor, and it does not say whether an initial access code arrives by physical mail. Missing for 10: documented MFA on the sign-in path, confirmation that no mailed PIN or in-person step is required, coverage of the CRA business account sign-in, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native founder, the published sign-in path is credential MFA an authorized human can complete remotely — not biometric liveness, an in-person visit, or a PIN by physical mail

citations.quote: To view your transmission history, sign in with your EFILE number and password and select the type of transmissions you would like to access
Use your EFILE number and password to: Maintain your account, Renew your account, View transmission history
